name: LT Foods Ltd
title: LT Foods Ltd - 532783 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Basmati volume up ~19% and FY26 EBITDA margin around 11.8% normalised, but management guides margins back to ~12% with gross margin held at 33-33.5% and RTH capacity delayed to Q2 FY27.

capex.quote: And the next year also will be in the same range.

triggers.label: RTH capacity constraint delays growth
triggers.quote: certain growth opportunities could not be fully serviced due to capacity constraints in RTH platform

triggers.label: Domestic paddy prices up 25-30%
triggers.quote: roughly 25% to 30% prices have gone up

triggers.label: Inventory ~250 days; payables ~100 days
triggers.quote: the inventory we have maintained that inventory levels of almost 250 days of inventory

triggers.label: Margins to return to ~12% EBITDA
triggers.quote: we will surely improve on the EBITDA margins by almost on that level. We were at 12% in the previous year.

guidance.quote: we are eying at 10% to 12% of growth on a long -term basis
this margin range of 33.5% or 33% will remain in the next financial year as well
we will surely improve on the EBITDA margins by almost on that level. We were at 12% in the previous year.
